mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the crane with the padded weight made the difference between holding a load and balancing the whole crane concrete; adding ballast then demonstrated the fix.

leastWorthwhile.text: Mounting the winch and adding the line were necessary but straightforward, with little to consider beyond following the only offered combination.

surprise.text: The pawl could hold the rope while the crane still began to tip; those are separate problems.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: even the forced assembly steps had clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. The short tests and explanations of leverage, balance and the pawl made the construction worth my time, and I would be curious to see what comes next.
